name: War Inc: Rising Hunting Mode Guide — Bosses, Tips and Rewards
title: War Inc: Rising Hunting Mode Guide — Best Heroes and Boss Strategy
meta_description: Master Hunting mode in War Inc: Rising. Guide to all 20 Hunting bosses, best heroes for each boss, rewards, and strategies for maximizing your Hunting runs.
author: Klown Kollege

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.content:
Hunting mode is one of the best sources of Forge Stones and Legendary hero shards. You fight bosses one at a time, and each has unique attack patterns and weaknesses. Building a dedicated Hunting team that consistently clears the highest difficulty is one of the best long-term investments you can make.

Here's how to pick the right heroes, understand the rewards, and maximize your daily Hunting runs.

sections.heading: How Hunting Mode Works
sections.content:
Each day brings a new boss rotation. Bosses have specific attack patterns, weaknesses, and phases. The mode resets daily, so you fight whoever is available that day.

Hunting favors single-target damage dealers over AoE specialists. Assassins and Rangers perform best here. You need a frontline Tank to keep the boss busy while your damage dealers work. Support with healing extends your team's survivability.

Higher difficulty levels yield better rewards. The jump from medium to hard is worth the extra effort.

sections.heading: Best Heroes for Hunting
sections.content:
- Ghost Assassin: Single-target burst. Deletes boss HP bars.
- Bone Marksman: Piercing shots from range. Prioritize getting this one.
- Mist Archer: Consistent DPS with stealth. Never stops dealing damage.
- Necromancer: Skeletons deal massive damage. Needs Goddess of War shielding.
- Radiant Warrior: Tank that also contributes damage. Shields team from boss AoE.
- Grace Priest: Healing keeps your team alive through boss phases.

Build a core Hunting team of 5-7 heroes and stick with it. Switching heroes between runs wastes resources.

sections.heading: Hunting Rewards — What to Expect
sections.content:
Higher difficulty means better rewards:
- Forge Stones: Common drop, essential for pushing merges past level 6.
- Gold: Always useful.
- Hero shards: Legendary shards from higher difficulties.

A dedicated Hunting team that clears the hardest difficulty daily will outpace players who ignore this mode. The Forge Stones alone make it worth the effort.

sections.heading: Daily Hunting Strategy
sections.content:
Always complete your daily Hunting runs. Even if you can't clear the highest difficulty, lower-tier rewards still add up over time.

Study each boss's attack patterns before the fight. Time your hero deployment to avoid AoE attacks. Save your hero skills for boss vulnerability phases to maximize damage.

The bosses have predictable patterns. Learn them once and you'll clear consistently.
